scope: Official BWM versus two-step early-stop adapter on the same frozen held-out window
summary: Early stopping preserved background and temporal quality and improved causal margin and flow EPE, but still regressed reference, endpoint, and flow-direction metrics, so it was rejected.
evidence: Action-causal margin improved 0.005644 to 0.006764 and flow EPE improved 0.4140 to 0.3946; background MAD slightly improved 0.007076 to 0.007056.
Future SSIM fell 0.958356 to 0.957623, endpoint SSIM fell 0.946902 to 0.946033, and flow-direction cosine fell 0.05909 to 0.05662.
lessons: Early stopping reduces but does not remove the action-fidelity tradeoff on this tiny adaptation set.
limitations: The held-out released demo is now validation evidence only; no independent test set remains and no real robot was run.
next_actions: Acquire a grouped multi-embodiment train-validation-test corpus before another promotion attempt.
